hypotheses.M1_quadratic_tensor_is_offdiagonal: At least half of the reduced quadratic tensor's Frobenius energy is off-diagonal for every family bank.
hypotheses.M2_offdiagonal_terms_are_causally_substa: The complete off-diagonal term set reaches at least 0.50 median downstream fidelity to the exact quadratic patch on both corpora.
hypotheses.M3_frozen_top64_pairs_are_useful: Sixty-four discovery-ranked interaction pairs reach at least 0.50 quadratic-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.M4_frozen_top256_pairs_are_sufficient: Two hundred fifty-six discovery-ranked interaction pairs reach at least 0.80 quadratic-patch fidelity on both corpora.
hypotheses.M5_activation_ranking_beats_weight_ranki: At budget 256, discovery-activation ranking exceeds coefficient-magnitude ranking by at least 0.10 on both corpora.
hypotheses.M6_activation_ranking_beats_random: At budget 256, discovery-activation ranking exceeds a fixed random ranking by at least 0.50 on both corpora.
hypotheses.M7_every_family_has_pair_k90_by4096: Every family reaches quadratic causal K90 by 4,096 interaction pairs on both corpora.
hypotheses.M8_pair_k90_is_ood_stable: For every family, FineWeb and TinyStories pair K90 differ by at most a factor of four.
